set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem uniformContinuousOn_composed_output_pair
  {α β γ δ : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] [UniformSpace γ] [UniformSpace δ]
  {f : α → β} {g : β → γ} {h : γ → δ}
  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hg : UniformContinuous g) (hh : UniformContinuous h)
  (s : Set α) (m : α → β) (hm : ∀ x, x ∈ s → m x = f x) :
  UniformContinuousOn (fun x => (g (m x), h (g (m x)))) s := by
  have h_eq : Set.EqOn (fun x => (g (f x), h (g (f x)))) (fun x => (g (m x), h (g (m x)))) s := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [← hm x hx]
  have h1 : UniformContinuous (fun x => g (f x)) := hg.comp hf
  have h2 : UniformContinuous (fun x => h (g (f x))) := hh.comp (hg.comp hf)
  have h_prod : UniformContinuous (fun x => (g (f x), h (g (f x)))) := by
    first
    | exact UniformContinuous.prodMk h1 h2
    | exact UniformContinuous.prod_mk h1 h2
    | fun_prop
  exact (h_prod.uniformContinuousOn (s := s)).congr h_eq
